editor.classification: Add a product metafield "{{ ns }}.classification" (one "System|Code|Title" per line or list item) for codes that show before the 3D model loads.
editor.compat: Add a "{{ ns }}.compatible_with" product metafield to list the apps and versions you tested.
editor.rooms: Add product metafields "{{ ns }}.area", "{{ ns }}.bedrooms", "{{ ns }}.bathrooms" and "{{ ns }}.storeys" for key specs that show before the 3D model loads.
editor.specs: Add product metafields in the "{{ ns }}" namespace for specs that show before the 3D model loads.
editor.takeoff: Add a product metafield "{{ ns }}.boq" (one row per line, cells split by |) for a table that shows before the 3D model loads, and "{{ ns }}.unit_prices" (JSON) for an indicative total.
